message.content:
This is a part for metal detectors, weigh stations, and x-ray units. Because it is a component of several different machines, the classification depends on which heading covers parts of those machines.

Relevant headings:
- Metal detectors fall under 9031.80 (measuring or checking instruments), and their parts under 9031.90.
- X-ray apparatus falls under 9022, and its parts under 9022.90.
- Weighing machines fall under 8423, and their parts under 8423.90.

Section XVI Note 2 and Section XVII/Chapter 90 notes direct that parts suitable for use with several machines are classified by their principal use. Here the item is a guide that keeps objects aligned for measuring, examination, or testing, and it is used in all three machine types. Chapter 90 is likely, since it covers both metal detectors and x-ray units.

I recall a CBP ruling on a work guide for such machines (NY N-series) that classified it in 9031.90, parts of measuring or checking instruments. Within 9031.90, the 10-digit statistical subheadings are 9031.90.9195 ("Other") and 9031.90.5400. Of these, 9031.90.9195 is the most likely fit.
